footer.aboutText: Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas is a premier authorized automotive CNG & LPG retrofitting and servicing center located in Garchuk, Guwahati. Specialized in sequential gas injection, computerized ECU calibration, and certified cylinder hydro-testing.
footer.disclaimer: Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas is an authorized automotive gas retrofitment facility in Guwahati, Assam. All kit installations strictly adhere to AIS/RTO safety regulations.
